component: OAuth username discovery and object reuse

quotes.text: creating another OAuth2Module with no username must not reuse the inner OAuth2 object

source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: When the refresh token or granted scope changes, the OAuth module can fill a strictly null username from preferred_username for the explicit Thundermail or external.test origins. It updates both wrapper and inner OAuth objects before saving the refresh token. The added unit test uses a fabricated URL-safe token and directly checks saved login fields, reuse for the learned username and non-reuse for another null username. This is a scoped identity and persistence contract; the test does not establish JWT cryptographic validity or support for arbitrary providers.
title: Thundermail sign-in learns the username before saving the refresh token
